title: Southern Thailand bombings trigger sharp drop in Malaysian border crossings
summary: RANTAU PANJANG: The number of Malaysians travelling to southern Thailand has declined, with only 1.15 million visitors recorded between January and October this year following several security incidents, including bomb attacks in the region.

title: Narathiwat seizes 349,000 packs of smuggled cigarettes
summary: Authorities seized 349,000 packs of untaxed cigarettes, worth about 31.4 million baht, during a raid on an abandoned house in Tak Bai district, Narathiwat, on Monday.
